purpose: Test one training-free successor to V71 that retains the fixed V70 within-member spatial rank field while restoring the paired V63 latent marginal inside target-free conditioning strata. Run one fresh stage-A screen and, only after an exact pass, one disjoint fresh stage-B confirmation under predeclared fair tail, spectral, and field gates.

authorization.user_instruction: The user explicitly instructed '다음으로 진행' after the sealed V71 result.
authorization.required_after_stage_B_pass: seal V72 and await a new explicit user approval before independent EAGLE access

parent_evidence.V71_development_role: model-development evidence motivating spatial rather than member-axis transport; never V72 selection evidence

fresh_stage_A_selection.source: target-free hash-stratified selection frozen in the V72 feasibility audit

fresh_stage_B_selection.source: target-free hash-stratified selection frozen in the V72 feasibility audit

candidate_construction.name: conditioning_stratified_spatial_quantile_transport
candidate_construction.conditioning_score: the target-free physical residual conditional mean field backbone plus the frozen scalar target_mean
candidate_construction.stratum_construction: stable ascending sort of all 64^3 conditioning-score voxels, with flattened voxel index as the secondary tie order, divided into sixteen contiguous equal-occupancy blocks of exactly 16384 voxels
transport_for_each_query_member_and_stra: stable ascending argsort of the fixed V70 raw latent values over the stratum voxel positions
stable ascending sort of the paired initial standard-normal innovation values over the identical stratum voxel positions
scatter the sorted innovation values into the voxel positions specified by the V70 rank order
candidate_construction.tie_rule: stable order with flattened voxel index as the deterministic secondary order; exact equal marginal values are indistinguishable and recorded
candidate_construction.exact_pre_inverse_invariant: candidate and independent-control latent multisets are bitwise identical separately within every query, member, and conditioning stratum
candidate_construction.spatial_property: candidate spatial rank order equals the raw V70 spatial rank order separately within every query, member, and stratum, except indistinguishable marginal ties
candidate_construction.physical_inverse: unchanged V63 bounded-mixture inverse, frozen target affine inverse, and one per-member residual DC projection before adding the unchanged backbone
candidate_construction.post_DC_caveat: the memberwise DC projection can break exact stratum multiset equality by a member-specific constant and is recorded diagnostically

fair_tail_gate.q99_999: absolute generated-minus-truth pooled log10rho q99.999 difference at most 0.1 dex in every domain
fair_tail_gate.Q4_physical_moment: generated-over-truth mean delta-squared ratio in [2/3,1.5] in every domain
fair_tail_gate.cube_maximum_energy_score: For each query, compute the unbiased scalar energy score of the sixteen generated per-cube log10rho maxima against that query truth maximum; average across sixteen queries. Candidate score must be strictly lower than the paired independent-control score in every domain.

unchanged_field_gate.field_requirements: all eight unchanged field_gate checks pass independently in TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift
unchanged_field_gate.explicit_spectral_requirement: generated total-power over truth is in [0.9,1.1] in both 3-6 and 6-10.0531 h/Mpc bands in every domain
unchanged_field_gate.residual_RMS_requirement: generated-over-truth residual RMS is in [0.9,1.1] in every domain

stage_A_gate.candidate_pass: all fair-tail, unchanged-field, explicit-spectral, residual-RMS, numerical, provenance, and firewall requirements pass in all three domains

stage_B_gate.authorization: only the canonical, hash-bound exact stage-A candidate pass
stage_B_gate.candidate_pass: the identical frozen candidate independently passes the identical stage-A requirements on stage B

fixed_branches.condition: stage A passes and single stage-B gate fails
both stage A and stage B pass

firewall.independent_EAGLE_access: forbidden without a new explicit user approval after both fresh stages pass
